About me

Coach La

I am a qualified personal trainer and nutrition coach. I have over ten years experience coaching all sorts of clients, including Cross-Fit athletes, general population, elderly and bariatric patients.

I have learned so much on my own personal health and fitness journey and I want to share that knowledge with you!

Whether you want in person training sessions, nutrition help, a structured meal plan or one on one coaching, I am your girl.

  • Level 4 Nutrition Coaching
  • Level 3 & 4 Personal Training
  • Bachelor of Law and Arts
  • First Aid
